policy: One explicit actionable card issue maps to its category. Multiple issues, unresolved contradictions and missing context require clarification. Other services are outside this desk.

cases.text: My purse was taken while shopping; the debit card was inside. I want to report the card stolen.
lost my bank crad can you help me report the loss
No purchase was unauthorized and the card is intact. I simply cannot locate my debit card.
I last saw my credit card at the railway station. It is gone and I want to report the loss.
There is a debit card payment to a shop I have never visited, and I did not approve it.
a card purhcase apeared that i never autorised
I still have my bank card. Someone made a payment with it without my consent.
Please check the unauthorized debit card payment on my latest statement.
The corner of my bank card broke off and split the chip.
my debit card plastci is craked badly
I have my card and do not want a new PIN. Its chip is physically broken.
While moving furniture I bent my credit card until it cracked. Help with the damaged card, please.
The supermarket terminal refused my debit card purchase this afternoon.
the paymet with my credit card was rejcted
My card is here and undamaged. The merchant keeps rejecting its payments.
I tried two times at the cafe and both payments with my bank card were declined.
Can you explain the steps to select a different debit card PIN number?
i wanna udpate the pin on my bank card
My card is neither missing nor broken. I want a different PIN for it.
For my payment card, how can I replace the PIN I currently use?
The bank issued my replacement debit card on Monday. When should the post bring it?
how long untill my replacment credit card is delivred
I do not need to change my PIN. I am only asking when my already requested replacement bank card will arrive.
Please give the expected arrival time for the replacement card sent to my address.
My camera's SD card snapped and I need another storage card.
Where do I update the PIN for my phone's SIM?
When will the replacement mouse I ordered reach my house?
I lost the access badge for my office building.
Please raise the spending limit on my credit card.
How can I activate the debit card I just received?
I need to buy a new washing machine.
Find me a direct flight to Lisbon next month.
The airline rejected my reservation, not my card payment. Help me book a flight.
I have forgotten my debit card PIN and cannot remember it.
Please cancel a transfer from my current account.
Help me design a congratulations card for a wedding.
My card has an issue but I cannot describe it yet.
Could you help me with what happened earlier?
Please deal with this problem.
I misplaced my debit card and separately want to update the PIN on my credit card.
My bank card is cracked. There is also a purchase I never authorized. I need both issues handled.
My replacement card has not arrived, and I want to change the PIN for another card.
One debit card was declined and my other card has been stolen. Please help with both cards.
I think the charge is mine, or perhaps it is not. I have no information to decide.
I said my card was gone, but actually it may still be here. I am unsure what is happening.
The payment succeeded. The payment did not succeed. I cannot determine which is true.
I am not certain whether I need to change my PIN or report a missing card.
There was some card trouble yesterday; I do not have details.
